{{Quote|They hit us with an ion cannon. Avionics are down. Comms are down!|The shuttle pilot|<ref name="Chapter 16" />}}
A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''pilot''' served in [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]'s [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Around [[9 ABY]], he and his co-[[pilot]] were pursued aboard the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Operating number|designated]] [[Shuttle 2743]] by the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray''-31-class patrol and attack craft]] ''[[Slave I]]'' while [[transport]]ing [[Doctor]] [[Penn Pershing]]. The ''Slave I'' immobilized the shuttle and clamped to it, the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] entering the [[Starship|vessel]]. After the co-pilot held Pershing at gunpoint, the pilot attempted to resolve the confrontation, but was shot [[Death|dead]] by his comrade.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Easy, pal. Okay? I'm not with him. We can work something out.|The shuttle pilot's last words|<ref name="Chapter 16" />}}
During the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]], the [[pilot]] served in a [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]].<ref name="Chapter 16" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> he was [[transport]]ing the [[Cloning|clone]] [[engineer]] [[Doctor]] [[Penn Pershing]] aboard the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Operating number|designated]] [[Shuttle 2743]] with a [[Unidentified Imperial shuttle co-pilot|co-pilot]]. However, they were pursued by the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray''-31-class patrol and attack craft]] ''[[Slave I]]'', which fired on the [[shuttle]]. The pilots attempted to outmaneuver the ''Slave I'', but Shuttle 2743 was soon immobilized by an [[Ion cannon]] shot.<ref name="Chapter 16" />

[[File:CapturingPershing-TMCh16.png|thumb|left|280px|The shuttle pilot and co-pilot are confronted by Din Djarin and Cara Dune]]
The shuttle pilot acknowledged the loss of avionics in the shuttle as well as the comms being disabled. [[Boba Fett]], the ''Slave I''{{'s}} pilot, ordered for the [[Starship|vessel's]] [[deflector shield]]s and [[transponder]] to be disabled in addition. The attack craft promptly clamped onto Shuttle 2743 and the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] entered with his [[The Mandalorian's IB-94 blaster pistol|blaster]] raised. The pilot and Pershing raised their hands, but the co-pilot held Pershing at gunpoint shortly after. As the New Republic [[marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]] entered the confrontation too, the pilot disassociated himself from his comrade and attempted to resolve the situation. The co-pilot abruptly shot him, however, and the pilot fell to the ground in a brief panic, [[Death|perishing]] thereafter.<ref name="Chapter 16" />

==Personality and traits==
The Imperial shuttle pilot was a [[human]] male with light skin and [[Color|green]] [[eye]]s. When Shuttle 2743 was hit with an ion cannon shot, the pilot assessed the system losses the vessel had taken. After his co-pilot held Pershing at gunpoint, he attempted to reason with Din Djarin by disassociating himself from his comrade, but was unsuccessful.<ref name="Chapter 16" />

==Equipment==
The pilot [[Clothing|wore]] a black [[flight suit]] with the [[Imperial crest]] on his shoulders. He also donned black [[glove]]s and an aviator hat with a built in [[comlink]].<ref name="Chapter 16" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial shuttle pilot appeared in "[[Chapter 16: The Rescue]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Peyton Reed]]<ref name="Chapter 16" /> and released on [[December 18]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}}</ref> Credited as "Pilot," he was played by [[Luke Baines]].<ref name="Chapter 16" />
